levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن بزيع

notes: «قال سألت سالم بن عبد الله» makes Salim the one asked and answering (rule 5). «أبيه» is the father whose prayer is asked about and whose words end the report; he is not named, so he is not identified. «صفية بنت أبي عبيد» and «وسألناه» are in the story, not links.
